It is also far from the 80-85% partial take-profit zone and the 90-95% close zone, so there is no valid REDUCE or CLOSE trigger. That keeps the original bearish bet alive without justifying a second same-day entry. The 76k DIP can still resolve with 10 hours left, while a new daily momentum trade is not clean enough to open from here. The correct action this cycle is to hold.
